name: AbuseIPDB - Network Device Logs with Blacklisted IPs
description: Correlates AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs with CommonSecurityLog (firewalls, proxies, IDS/IPS) to detect inbound and outbound network traffic involving known abusive IP addresses. Matches both SourceIP (inbound threats) and DestinationIP (C2/exfiltration).
query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
let IPSet = toscalar(BlacklistedIPs | summarize make_set(IpAddress));
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where SourceIP in (IPSet) or DestinationIP in (IPSet)
| extend MatchedIP = iff(set_has_element(IPSet, SourceIP), SourceIP, DestinationIP)
| extend Direction = iff(SourceIP == MatchedIP, "Inbound", "Outbound")
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.MatchedIP == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct, Activity, MatchedIP, Direction, SourceIP, DestinationIP, DestinationPort, AbuseScore, Country, LogSeverity
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimeGenerated desc
